items.title: Open-weight AI models add new spark to China, Silicon Valley's AI race
items.summary: Morning Brief Host Julie Hyman is joined by Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Ines Ferré and Breaking News Reporter Jake Conley to assess and discuss the rising competition between open-weight AI models from China — which are public to download and modify — and Silicon Valley's top artificial intelligence developers.

items.title: Elon Musk Made 53-Year-Old Colorado Couple Rich. Now He’s The Biggest Risk To Their Retirement
items.summary: A $2,000 bet on a then-unknown electric car company grew into a nearly $10 million fortune for a Colorado couple in their fifties. Now the same grip that built their wealth may be the thing that unravels it.

items.title: Tesla Rival BYD Ramping Up Sales On Overseas Demand, Flash Charging
items.summary: The world's largest EV maker is are ramping up thanks to overseas demand and improved production of its flash-charging Blade 2.0 batteries.

items.title: Rivian Automotive Stock Asks The Market's Price For Sales That Do Not Yet Pay
items.summary: The stock changes hands at about the same price per dollar of sales as the broad market, while its own sales still arrive with a deep operating loss attached.
